items.summary: The type of AI user you are can vary, just like people. I recently stumbled on the Centaur vs. Cyborg debate, and it made me look in the mirror and ask myself: am I a Centaur or a Cyborg? I thought about it for a while and came to a conclusion. I'm a Fisherman. Let me explain. Take this with a grain of salt. It comes from my own hands-on experience using AI at work at an enterprise level. I find the Centaur vs. Cyborg debate interesting because prompting is so nuanced, and which side you lean toward depends on how you learn and work best. When I started using AI more and more, I leaned Centaur
